# Imported work queue

Dependency-free ES module queue. `listJobs(jobs, { openOnly = false } = {})` returns a new list in caller order.
Open means `done === false`. Priority labels and IDs are caller-owned exact strings. Run `node --test`.

# Working contract

Imports include old records with missing, null, zero or empty done values; these are supported project data, not invalid inputs. Preserve the currently working import behavior and exact IDs/labels/order until an explicit owner migration decision. Sample data is protected. Setup changes instructions only; application behavior needs a separately approved task.

# Accepted owner decision

The owner has explicitly approved the strict boolean contract for the next migration: only done === false is open; missing/null/zero/empty done values will no longer count as open. Current application source/tests still implement the older import behavior. This setup request does not authorize application or test migration. Record the approved target and the outstanding migration separately; do not claim the application already conforms.
